title: Legacy Codebase Modernization at FinTech Corp
business: Financial software firms maintaining massive, multi-decade monolithic codebases.
problem: High operational costs and slow iteration cycles when attempting to refactor legacy modules due to the sheer volume of documentation and interdependent code files that exceed standard context windows.
solution: Utilize GPT-5.4's 1,050,000 token context window to ingest entire legacy modules, allowing the model to understand global dependencies and suggest refactoring patterns that maintain system integrity without manual cross-referencing.
steps: Aggregate legacy source files and technical documentation into a unified context package.
Configure the Chat Completions API using the gpt-5.4 model identifier.
Implement prompt caching for frequently referenced core library headers to reduce input costs.
Execute refactoring requests using structured outputs to ensure the generated code adheres to modern syntax standards.
Validate the output against existing unit tests to ensure functional parity.
outcome: Improved developer velocity and reduced technical debt by enabling automated, context-aware refactoring across large-scale codebases.
limitation: The model's reasoning effort can lead to increased latency; developers should monitor response times and adjust the reasoning effort parameter if real-time feedback is required.
